about: The home page reel. videos/hero.mp4 plays these scenes in order, scene_seconds each, crossfading over fade_seconds, and loops seamlessly; each scene's caption links its paper. Rebuild the video with web-pages/scripts/make-hero-reel.py after editing. source is a video URL or a local file, start is in seconds of the source, speed plays it faster than recorded, and filter is an ffmpeg filtergraph from [0:v] to [v] that cuts the scene to 2:1.

scenes.note: The raw fly-over recording behind the GreenScapes SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 fast-forward (2560x1600, 60 fps, not public). The crop keeps the scene's empty edge out of the top and the recording's black bar out of the bottom; past about 620 s the edge shows.
